ctx.x: Well, what happened was, when I was about seven, there was a man that played a cornet, named Professor Cobb, a rarity. And I asked my mother if I could take lessons with Professor Cobb, and she said yes. And Professor Cobb taught me for two weeks, 25 cents a lesson. And then he talked to my mother and he said, "Mrs. Price, your son ain't got it. He just don't have it. He don't understand what it's all about." And she said, "Well, do you think that he can learn?"
